optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        SUM(sr_fee) AS ctr_total_return,
        AVG(SUM(sr_fee)) OVER (PARTITION BY sr_store_sk) AS avg_total
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_state = 'TN') AS filtered_store
    ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = filtered_store.s_store_sk
JOIN customer c
    ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (ctr1.avg_total * 1.2)
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
